people.name: Daniel J. Callaghan
people.extract: Daniel Judson Callaghan was a United States Navy officer who served his country in two wars, in a three-decades-long career. Callaghan served on several ships during his first 20 years of service, including escort duties during World War I, and also filled some shore-based administrative roles. He later came to the attention of President Franklin D. Roosevelt, who appointed Callaghan as his naval aide in 1938.
highlights: United States Navy officer who served in two wars.
Served escort duties during World War I.
Appointed naval aide to President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

people.name: Thaksin Shinawatra
people.bio: Prime Minister of Thailand from 2001 to 2006
people.extract: Thaksin Shinawatra is a Thai former politician, businessman, and police officer who served as the 23rd prime minister of Thailand from 2001 until his overthrow in 2006. Since 2009 he has also been a citizen of Montenegro.
highlights: Served as 23rd prime minister of Thailand from 2001.
Also a citizen of Montenegro since 2009.

people.name: James Naismith (chemist)
people.extract: James Henderson Naismith is a Scot, Professor of Structural Biology and since autumn of 2023 the Head of the Mathematical, Physical, and Life Science Division (MPLS) Division at the University of Oxford. He is also currently Vice-President (non-clinical) of The Academy of Medical Sciences and a Fellow of Jesus College. He was the acting and inaugural Director (2017-2023) of the Rosalind Franklin Institute and Director of the Research Complex at Harwell. He served as Bishop Wardlaw Professor of Chemical Biology at the University of St Andrews. He was a member of Council of the Royal Society (2021-2022) and the Vice-Chair of Council (2022-2024) of the European X-ray Free Electron Laser.
highlights: Head of Mathematical, Physical, and Life Science Division, Oxford.
Vice-President (non-clinical) of The Academy of Medical Sciences.
Inaugural Director of the Rosalind Franklin Institute (2017-2023).
